messages.content: You are a skeptical research-methods reviewer. Return valid JSON only.

{"request": "We are developing a WORLD-MODEL SECURITY paper. Existing candidates have been tested or rejected: data poisoning and persistent shared-memory rule corruption; retrieval capture; measurement substitution; rank/cross-candidate sampler coupling; gradient reparameterization; latent coordinate transforms; imagined-vs-real origin routing; recurrence self-excitation; goal leakage; uncertainty decomposition and epistemic disagreement collapse; temporal residual coupling; policy/action reflection; query-only planner interference; normalization carryover. Strong frozen baselines include native MBRL-Lib five-member GaussianMLP+CEM CartPole/HalfCheetah and pretrained TD-MPC2 walker/reacher/cup. We need a broad one-sentence claim plausibly novelty 7-7.5, with an executable short gate and eventual multi-task evidence. Do not suggest generic model poisoning, backdoors, uncertainty collapse, action desynchronization, latent perturbation, reward tampering, or ordinary compounding error. Focus on a world-model-specific invariant at the interface between factual prediction, counterfactual planning, and real feedback. Return JSON with 5 candidates, each fields: one_sentence_claim, exact_security_operation, preserved_audit_invariants, expected_task_failure, closest_direct_priors_and_urls, two_seed_gate, why_distinct. Be skeptical and reject anything too close to known work."}
